updateIntro.architecture: LogHome uses a cross-platform H5 architecture and currently supports synchronized updates across the browser and Android apps.
updateIntro.strategy: All platforms follow the same update policy for core features, and app users also get enhanced features powered by local capabilities.
updateIntro.hotUpdateDesc: LogHome supports zero-downtime hot updates on all platforms, and you can keep using the app during an update. In some cases the service may be briefly interrupted and will resume once the update is complete.
updateIntro.appUpdateDesc: The LogHome app is updated infrequently, usually to enhance local features. We recommend that all app users download and install these updates.
